name: LotKeys Facebook Posting Buddy
notes: Adds one optional Vehicle Profile walkaround video under Facebook's 60-second limit.
Loads and checks the video only after fields and photos are complete and Add Video is pressed.
Preserves completed photos on mixed media inputs and leaves fields/photos untouched on video failure.
Retains V0.1.16 posting timers, neutral handoff, accent spinner, grey/blur lock and manual final publish.
